title: When Do Type-Specific Wages Buffer Distributional Incidence in TANK?
abstract: arXiv:2605.15614v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When do relative wages buffer the unequal incidence of aggregate shocks? I derive a consumption-gap decomposition and a present-value condition for partial offset in a TANK model. An extension separates wage-setting demand elasticity from substitution between labor segments and allows each segment to contain both financial types. With a zero inherited wage gap and a same-sign discounted wedge, substitution above one gives offsetting earnings reallocation; substitution below one gives amplification. The channel disappears when financial types have identical segment exposure. Numerical experiments assess these mechanisms, shock persistence, policy feedback, and aggregate-IRF matching. In the nested perfect-alignment monetary benchmark, the peak consumption gap is about two-fifths smaller under type-specific wages than under the common-wage closure. translated_title: 在TANK模型中，类型特定工资何时能缓冲冲击的分布性效应？
translated_abstract: 相对工资何时能缓冲总量冲击带来的不平等分布效应？我在TANK模型中推导出一个消费缺口分解方法以及部分抵消效应的现值条件。一个模型扩展将工资设定中的需求弹性与劳动细分部门之间的替代效应分离开来，并允许每个细分部门同时包含两种金融类型。在继承的工资差距为零且折现楔子同号的条件下，当替代弹性大于1时，会产生抵消性的收入再分配；当替代弹性小于1时，则会产生放大效应。当金融类型在各细分部门的暴露完全相同时，该渠道便会消失。数值实验评估了这些机制、冲击持续性、政策反馈以及总量脉冲响应（IRF）匹配情况。在嵌套的完全对齐货币政策基准中，类型特定工资下的峰值消费缺口比共同工资设定下小约五分之二。这些属于条件性的模型比较，而非实证效应估计或福利排序。
tldr: 在TANK模型中，当劳动细分部门间的替代弹性大于1且工资差距折现楔子同号时，类型特定工资可通过抵消性收入再分配缓冲总量冲击的分布效应，使峰值消费缺口比共同工资情形缩小约五分之二。
en_tdlr: In a TANK model, type-specific wages buffer the distributional incidence of aggregate shocks—shrinking the peak consumption gap by about two-fifths relative to common wages—when labor-segment substitution exceeds one and the discounted wage wedge shares the same sign.
